name: personal-pocket-factory
title: 戴森环计划
author: 虚无群友
description:
每人一条专属戴森环，只要偶尔上线就一直是你的，但一颗矿都没有。
资源全在五个公共星球上，而那些星球隔二到七小时就整颗清空。

· 手搓木箱做出来的直接是关联箱。放在环外就是投递口，货直通环里的收货箱，全宇宙同时最多 8 个。
· 12 种科技瓶各记各的账，每种经验的十进制位数就是它给的级数。环长 =（总等级 + 4）× 16 格。
· 已研究的科技会定期被撤销，越靠后的科技漏得越快。每轮的强度是随机的，风平浪静和成片掉级都可能。
· 体力每秒 +1，1 点换 1 个瓶子。收货箱里的瓶子还会自动兑换，和手动兑换共用体力池。
· 长期不上线，环先转公共任人拆解，再久会被回收。经验永远不受影响。

支持 11 种语言，跟随客户端自动切换。

交流群 293280221
项目地址 https://github.com/sandboxtech/personal_pocket_factory

Personal Pocket Factory: every player gets a private ring that holds no ore at all and is never wiped with the planets - it stays yours as long as you drop in now and then. All resources sit on five public planets that are wiped clean every two to seven hours. Hand-crafted wooden chests come out as linked chests: place one outside your ring and everything that goes in feeds straight home, up to eight per player universe-wide. Twelve science-pack ledgers are tracked separately, each contributing as many levels as it has decimal digits, and the total sets how long your ring grows. Researched technologies decay on their own schedule, faster the deeper they sit in the tree.
